title: Abbas naam hai mera
body:
Abbas naam hai mera
yabnaz zahra yaa abbas..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
mai ain se hussain ka aashiq bhi ishq bhi
be se hu buturab ki mai hasrate bhi
<<DIVIDER>>
zahir alif se hai abu talib ki aa gahi
aur seen se hasan ki samaj bujh sath bhi
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas dekhne mei faqad mera naam hai
darasl yeh hussain ke lashkar ka naam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas naam hai mera..(3)
maanga hai rab se maalike kaunain ne mujhe
<<DIVIDER>>
beta kaha hai maadar e hasnain ne mujhe
1. asma e panjetan ka asasa hai mera naam
<<DIVIDER>>
alfaz hai tawaaf me kaaba hai mera naam
israar aur ramuz ki duniya hai mera naam
<<DIVIDER>>
khud mustafa ki beti ne mera naam
bejaan nahi hai harf koi mere naam me
<<DIVIDER>>
simti hui hai naade ali mere naam me
2. tauheed ko hai naaz khudae wafa hu mai
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil kusha ka laal hu mushkil kusha hu mai
barso jabeen e shere khuda me raha hu mai
<<DIVIDER>>
dohraya jab ali ko khuda ne bana hu mai
khilqat mei meri dakhl nahi maao teen ko
<<DIVIDER>>
tohfa hu mai batul ka ummul banin ko
3. qehre khuda ki bolti tasweer meri tegh
<<DIVIDER>>
rooho pe maut karti hai tehreer meri tegh
tegho me misle aaya e tatheer meri tegh
<<DIVIDER>>
toofaane nuh khwaab hai taabeer meri tegh
ismat ki pehredaar hai tatheer ki qasam
<<DIVIDER>>
yeh choti zulfiqar hai shabbir ki qasam
4. talwar meri jaaegi ran me jidhar jidhar
<<DIVIDER>>
baarish waha pe hogi saro ki sarar sarar
ashal k paav peesege tumko karar karar
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhegi maut khud yeh nazaare tukar tukar
san san ki saut aisi sama'at me chaegi
<<DIVIDER>>
dhad dhad girege dhad na sada tumko aaegi
5. mai chahta hu quwat e baazu pe jang ho
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhu to tumko kitney bahadur ho shamiyo
manzur yeh nahi hai to khud faisla karo
<<DIVIDER>>
dikhlau maujizat mai apne jo tum kaho
darya pe haath dhoge abhi tum hayaat se
<<DIVIDER>>
apne saro ko kaatoge khud apne haath se
6. aise karunga waar sambhal ne na dunga mai
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu bhi tumko aaj badalne na dunga mai
talwaar kya zabaan bhi chalne na dunga mai
<<DIVIDER>>
nazro ke daaere se nikalne na dunga mai
meri hai kaaenaat kaha bachke jaaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
sunlo jaha chipogey waha mujhko paaoge
7. tumko ghamand fauj pe qasrat pe hai gurur
<<DIVIDER>>
in baazuo ke zor ka tumko nahi shauur
pal me nikaal dungaa mai zehno ka har futoor
<<DIVIDER>>
dozakh ka naam aaj se hoga yazidpur
hum kehke yaa ali jo abhi tegh uthaege
<<DIVIDER>>
murde tumhaare zere kafan thar tharaaege
8. mashur hai yeh baat khuda ki khudaai me
<<DIVIDER>>
maahir hai meri tegh safo ki safaai me
tum kya mai do jahaan dubo du taraai me
<<DIVIDER>>
daste khuda ka zor hai meri kalaai me
chahu toh baithe baithe mai ash'al ki zeen par
<<DIVIDER>>
lehra ke aasmaan ko ulat du zameen par
9. aalam tha tera saal me aisa jalaal ka
<<DIVIDER>>
siffin me badal diya naksha jidaal ka
ab toh shabaab aaya hai mere kamaal ka
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas aaj ho gaya battees(32) saal kaa..(2)
sun lo qaza ke ghaat utaaruga mai tumhe
<<DIVIDER>>
ghera hai tumne gher ke maarungaa mai tumhe
10. dunya na samjhi mir takallum yeh falsafa
<<DIVIDER>>
parcham hai surkh gumbade ibne batul ka
yaani ruki nahi hai abhi jange karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
aur aa rahi hai roza e abbas se sada
rokega mujhko tab na nawaasa rasool ka
<<DIVIDER>>
mehdi ke saath loonga mai badlaa batool ka
author: Mir Hassan Mir
